events.body:
## Context

blt-ideas has no tests and no row in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`, but `parse_idea_file`, `sort_key` and `build_overlap_matrix` have non-trivial regexes. The page is regenerated on every deploy, so a regression silently breaks the catalog.

## What to do

1. Add `blt-ideas/tests/test_generate_page.py` (unittest + tempfile): title cleanup, one-liner extraction, discussion number, `E.1`/`L2`/`M-S` ordering, symmetric overlap, unknown ID error.
2. Add `blt-ideas\tpython\tpython -m unittest discover -s tests` to `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] At least 6 tests pass
- [ ] No network calls
- [ ] `scripts/ci/test.sh blt-ideas` passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-ideas
```

---
